messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "patients allergic to pantoprazole or similar medicines"
set: ["patients allergic to pantoprazole or similar medicines", "allergic reaction to pantoprazole", "similar medicines", "allergy to similar medicines", "patients with severe allergic reaction after taking pantoprazole", "allergy to ondansetron or similar medicines (dolasetron, granisetron, palonosetron)", "pantoprazole", "ingredients similar to meloxicam", "pantoprazole (oral/injection)", "allergic to tirzepatide", "allergic reaction to omeprazole", "increased risk in patients with allergy to sulfa medicines or penicillin", "allergic to other medications", "allergic reaction to allopurinol", "allergic reaction to Metformin", "allergic reaction to Trazodone"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
